invalid/10-tampered-amount.json.why: signature no longer covers the mutated amount

invalid/11-valid-sig-wrong-prev.json.why: signature honest, chain link wrong — signature checks are necessary, not sufficient

invalid/13-v02-rederivation-mismatch.jso.why: embedded tx_hash does not re-derive from the disclosed bytes (§8.4) — signature honest, disclosure inconsistent

invalid/14-v02-attachment-dangling.json.why: attaches_to does not match the receipt's entry hash (§8.2)

invalid/16-v02-duplicate-key-entry.json.why: duplicate key in the entry file itself: same signature, same entry_hash under last-wins parsing, a field no check ever sees — verifiers MUST parse with duplicate detection (§5)

invalid/17-v02-integer-overflow.json.why: integer beyond 2^53-1: a double-backed JSON stack would re-serialize it into a different entry_hash (§5 bound)

invalid/18-v02-attachment-settled-null-t.why: attachment final_status settled with tx_hash null — mirror of the receipt-leg guard (§8.4 / issue #9)

invalid/19-v02-small-order-key.json.why: identity-point public key with zero scalar: the signature equation degenerates and mainstream libraries ACCEPT it — an entry signed with no secret. Verifiers MUST reject small-order keys before signature math (§6 / issue #12, corpus H5)

invalid/20-v02-wrong-version-field.json.why: a 0.2 entry carrying the v0.1 field name prev_receipt_hash: version dispatch must reject the other version's names, not merely not look for them (§4.0 / issue #10, corpus H22)

valid/05-v02-receipt-pending.json.note: pending + no attachment = dispute-grade for content, NOT payment finality (§8.3)

valid/08-v02-attachment-failed-2814.json.why: the false-assurance case (x402#2814): settle claimed processing/success, no tx landed — derives failed + null; the verbatim digest carries the claim

valid/09-v02-attachment-failed-non-objec.why: valid JSON that is NOT an object (bare string) — non-conforming per §8.4, derives failed/null instead of crashing; also demonstrates multiple attachments per receipt (seq 2 after seq 1)

valid/10-v02-attachment-failed-dupkey.js.why: duplicate keys in the verbatim settle response are non-conforming (§8.4): last-wins and first-wins parsers must not derive opposite finality from identical bytes — derives failed/null; bytes from the hostile-corpus review (sha256 5dd9b467...)
